# Lab 2: Inference (Permutation and Bootstrapping)

## Investigating “yes/no” questions with permutation

### State your hypotheses

H0 : There *is no* difference between lead levels in the drip line compared to the rest of the yard. Aka, the difference is 0.

H1 : There *is* a difference between lead levels in the drip line compared to the rest of the yard. Aka, the difference is not 0. 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
set.seed(222)
soil_data <- read_csv("labs/data/exide-soil-cores.csv")
unique(soil_data$location_code)
```

Calculate the difference in means between the drip line and yard observations in the sample. Remember, this should be a single number (not a data frame or pair of means).
```{r}
drip <- filter(soil_data, location_code == "DL")
yard <- filter(soil_data, location_code == "YD")

mean_diff <- mean(drip$pb_ppm) - mean(yard$pb_ppm)
print(paste("Difference in Means = ", mean_diff))
```


### Shuffle the predictor variable and recalculate the statistic
```{r}
soil_shuffled <- soil_data |> 
    mutate(loc_code_shuffled = sample(location_code)) |> 
    summarize(mean_pb = mean(pb_ppm), .by = loc_code_shuffled)

mean_diff_shuff <- soil_shuffled$mean_pb[1] - soil_shuffled$mean_pb[2]
print(paste("Difference in Means = ", mean_diff_shuff))
```

### Repeat shuffling with replicate()
```{r}
shuff_replicated <- replicate(10000, {
    mutate(soil_data, shuff_location_code = sample(location_code)) |> 
    summarize(pb_mean = mean(pb_ppm), .by = shuff_location_code)

    soil_shuffled$mean_pb[2] - soil_shuffled$mean_pb[1]
})
```

```{r}
tibble(diff_means = shuff_replicated) |> 
    ggplot(aes(diff_means)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 5)

```
